thought.text: Jalur Google OAuth terbuka penuh. Ini kuncinya — mari saya uji end-to-end dengan akun Google milikmu.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && grep -oE 'client_id=[0-9a-z\-]+' <<< "$(curl -s -X POST 'https://dash.allmodels.io/api/auth/sign-in/social' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"provider":"google","callbackURL":"https://dash.allmodels.io/"}')" | head -1; echo "--- state & verifier flow: apakah PKCE wajib?"; curl -s -X POST 'https://dash.allmodels.io/api/auth/sign-in/social' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"provider":"google","callbackURL":"https://dash.allmodels.io/","disableRedirect":true}' | head -c 600

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && grep -oE 'client_id=[0-9a-z\\-]+' <<< \"$(curl -s -X POST 'https://dash.allmodels.io/api/auth/sign-in/social' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"provider\":\"google\",\"callbackURL\":\"https://dash.allmodels.io/\"}')\" | head -1; echo \"--- state & verifier flow: apakah PKCE wajib?\"; curl -s -X POST 'https://dash.allmodels.io/api/auth/sign-in/social' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"provider\":\"google\",\"callbackURL\":\"https://dash.allmodels.io/\",\"disableRedirect\":true}' | head -c 600", "summary": "Inspect Google OAuth client id and PKCE", "security_risk": "LOW"}

summary: Inspect Google OAuth client id and PKCE
